skill.name: remotion-license
skill.description: Find Remotion license information, FAQs, terms, and where to buy a license.
skill.summary: Locate Remotion licensing documentation, common questions, legal terms, and the license purchase page.
skill.author: remotion-dev

security_audit.summary: All four static findings are false positives: the URLs identify licensing documentation, legal terms, or a license purchase page. No evidence found of credential collection, data exfiltration, automatic purchasing, or prompt injection in the reviewed files.

static_findings.snippet: You can buy a license on [remotion.pro](https://www.remotion.pro/license).

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:11 links to Remotion license documentation on remotion.dev. It is a plain reference without executable requests or instructions to transmit sensitive data.
SKILL.md:12 links to the licensing FAQ on remotion.dev, directly supporting the stated purpose. No data payload, credential request, or unrelated destination appears.
SKILL.md:13 provides a terms and conditions reference on remotion.dev. The documentation link does not execute code or instruct the assistant to disclose private information.
SKILL.md:15 identifies the remotion.pro license purchase page, consistent with the declared purpose. It does not instruct automatic payment, collect payment details, or execute a transaction.

content.value_statement: Remotion licensing questions require the right documentation and purchase information. This skill directs your assistant to license guidance, frequently asked questions, legal terms, and the purchase page.
actual_capabilities: Identify the Remotion license documentation URL.
Provide the dedicated Remotion license FAQ URL.
Locate the Remotion terms and conditions resource.
Point users to the Remotion license purchase page.
Direct licensing questions toward the relevant linked resource.
limitations: The skill contains links, not a local copy of the licensing terms.
Reading current linked content requires browsing access from the host assistant or user.
The skill does not independently verify eligibility, pricing, or compliance and does not provide legal advice.
The skill does not purchase licenses, process payments, or manage license accounts.

use_cases.title: Locate Developer Licensing Guidance
use_cases.description: Find the license documentation and FAQ before evaluating licensing requirements for a Remotion project.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Procurement Review
use_cases.description: Collect the terms and conditions and purchase page for an internal software procurement review.

use_cases.title: Find Sources for Legal Review
use_cases.description: Locate the linked license and terms resources for a legal review of planned Remotion use.

prompt_templates.title: Find the License Documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Where can I read the Remotion license documentation?
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: locate the main licensing resource.

prompt_templates.title: Locate Common Licensing Answers
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the Remotion license FAQ and terms and conditions links.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Purchase References
prompt_templates.prompt: List the Remotion license documentation, FAQ, terms, and purchase page for procurement review. Do not initiate a purchase.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: assemble references for a purchasing decision.

prompt_templates.title: Review Sources for a Planned Project
prompt_templates.prompt: For [project context], consult the linked Remotion licensing sources if browsing is available. Cite relevant passages and separate documented requirements from unresolved questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: support a source-based review without assuming eligibility.

output_examples.input: Where can I find Remotion licensing information?
Where are the legal terms and the license purchase page?
output: Review the current terms and purchase details before making a decision.

best_practices: Read the current linked sources before relying on specific licensing requirements.
Provide your project context when asking the assistant to consult the licensing documentation.
Use qualified legal review for unresolved licensing questions or contractual decisions.
anti_patterns: Treating resource links as proof that a project meets license requirements.
Expecting the skill to purchase a license or enter payment information.
Assuming prices or license terms are stored locally and remain unchanged.

faq.question: What does this skill provide?
faq.answer: It provides references to Remotion license documentation, a licensing FAQ, terms and conditions, and the license purchase page.

faq.question: Does it include the complete license text?
faq.answer: No. The skill links to external documentation instead of storing the full license text.

faq.question: Can it determine whether my project needs a paid license?
faq.answer: Not independently. Review the current documentation with your project context and seek qualified advice when requirements remain unclear.

faq.question: Can it buy a license for me?
faq.answer: No. It points to the purchase page but includes no payment processing or license purchasing workflow.

faq.question: Does it require browsing access?
faq.answer: The bundled links are available without browsing. Reading their current contents requires browsing access from your assistant or browser.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools. Access to linked pages depends on the host environment.
